title: Space Station UV Shield Calibration
description: You are a technician aboard a space station who must locate and equip experimental UV-filtering sunglasses, then walk through the hallway to calibrate them against three simulated solar flare bursts. Each flare changes the environment lighting dramatically, and you must activate the glasses' filter mode at the right moment to protect your vision and log the radiation data.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a space station UV shield calibration simulation. Load space_ship_hallway.glb as the main environment and SunglassesKhronos.glb as a collectible item placed on a crate or surface midway through the hallway. Use GLTFLoader to load both assets. Set up a first-person camera with PointerLockControls so the user can walk through the hallway using WASD keys. Add dim ambient light (0x334466) and a few blue-white point lights along the hallway ceiling to simulate ship interior lighting. The interaction flow has 5 steps: (1) The user walks forward through the hallway toward the sunglasses, which glow with a subtle pulsing emissive outline using a yellow point light oscillating in intensity. (2) When the user gets within 2 units of the sunglasses, a prompt appears saying 'Press E to pick up UV Shield Glasses'. Pressing E attaches the glasses model to the camera slightly below center to simulate wearing them, and a HUD text updates to 'UV Shield: Standby'. (3) After pickup, a 3-second countdown triggers the first solar flare: the hallway floods with intense orange-white directional light and a screen overlay tints warm. The user must press F to activate the filter, which applies a blue-tinted transparent screen overlay and dims the flare effect. (4) Two more flares trigger at 8-second intervals with increasing intensity, each requiring the user to press F to toggle the filter on. If the user fails to activate in 3 seconds, the screen flashes red with a warning. (5) After all three flares, a completion panel shows calibration results with a success percentage based on reaction times. Display a click-to-start overlay that activates pointer lock. Add a simple HUD using an HTML overlay div showing the current status and flare counter. Ensure the hallway is scaled so the user can walk through it comfortably at human scale.
